title: INFLUENCE Esp Hitbox no ban Universal
features:
INFLUENCE v2 | Hitbox | ESP | CoreUI

+ PvP Dominance: Perfect for all competitive and team games.

+ Command recognition: Instant tactical advantage: if you play in a mode where there are commands, the script finds your team and the opponent's team and highlights them with the color of the hitbox.

+ Your team: 🟢 glows green.

+ Opponents: 🔴 are highlighted in red.

+ Friends: 🟠 Your friends are highlighted in orange, which prevents accidental attack or confusion. (can be turned on or off)

+ Hitbox Control: Customizable hitbox expansion for enemies only. 

+ Managing the transparency of hitboxes and ESP 

+ Multiple FFA modes available for an enjoyable game experience**

+ Landing Protection: The mistake in Roblox is that if you have hitboxes enabled and the player for whom the hitbox will be increased gets into a transport, he will simply freeze and exit the game. But in my scenario, the hitboxes shrink to their normal size when boarding vehicles, which prevents accidents in Roblox. Stealth: The menu and all the elements are hidden in CoreGui, which ensures 99% invisibility, but you are not protected from the risk of being banned if you behave too suspiciously! + also in some games (Prison Life is an additional feature that allows you to kill players by tapping on them)

(Toggle: right shift)
